text: During the three days of travel, Abraham moves under a suspended sentence. Nothing happens; everything happens. The servants are present, and so are the wood, the knife, and the fire; the instruments of the act have received their names before the act itself. Obedience is before him, horror beside it, and neither prevails. Faith here has little of feeling in it; it is a geometry measured by the road, the servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire.
